verdict.rationale: EBANX documents a backward-compatibility commitment: older endpoints remain available so existing integrations keep working without changes. It also flags a deprecated authentication method with a migration guide to JWS, which shows deprecation is communicated in practice. However, nothing in the evidence describes an explicit API versioning scheme or a formal deprecation policy with timelines or notice periods. Missing for 10: an explicit API versioning scheme (version identifiers or headers), a published deprecation policy with sunset timelines and notice periods, a changelog, and independent corroboration.
